message.text: It looks like memopayload.Runner.RunOnce is never invoked anywhere, even in tests, and there's no interface requiring it. I want to confirm this by reading the actual files, noting that both *memopayload.Runner and *s3presign.Runner declare a RunOnce method.

Confirming memopayload's Runner is unused elsewhere—my earlier search across all file types found only RebuildMemoPayload calls, so this looks like dead code. I'll double-check the server.go context lines just to be sure.

h08.

Two types declare `RunOnce`, and only one of them is actually called from production code.

- `*s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — yes, invoked — called at startup by `Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go:163`, and also internally on each tick by its own `Runner.Run` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`.
- `*memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — no — it has no callers anywhere. Nothing constructs `memopayload.NewRunner`, and the only uses of the `memopayload` package are the two direct calls to the package-level function `RebuildMemoPayload` from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, which bypass the `Runner` type entirely. So `memopayload.Runner` and its `RunOnce` are effectively dead code.

I checked test files too (`server/runner/s3presign/runner_test.go` is the only test touching these packages, and it does not call `RunOnce`), so neither declaration has a test-only caller either.
